issue.title: Declare permissions for the CI workflow jobs

labels.name: github_actions
labels.description: Pull requests that update GitHub Actions code

issue.body:
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` declares no `permissions:` anywhere, so its three jobs (`lint-and-test`, `frontend`, `docker-build`) run with whatever the repository default gives the token. All they do is check out the code, run tests and build an image, so read access to the contents is enough. Every other workflow in the repo already says what it needs: `codeql.yml`, `greeting.yml`, `labeler.yml`, `release-image.yml` and `stale.yml`.

CodeQL flags this as `actions/missing-workflow-permissions`, three times, once per job.

What to do:

- Add `permissions:` with `contents: read` to the three jobs, or once at the top of the workflow if that reads better.
- Check the coverage upload still works. `codecov/codecov-action` needs no token for a public repo, but it is the one step that talks to something outside.

Done when the three `actions/missing-workflow-permissions` alerts are gone and CI still passes on a PR, coverage upload included.

issue.body:

Your specific assignment file: `assignments/assignment-9/yamini.md`

## 📝 The Process
1. **Pull Latest Changes**: Ensure you run `git pull` from the `main` branch so you have the latest Assignment 9 folder and your markdown file.

7. **Submit a PR**: Commit your changes and create a Pull Request.
